Terms and Conditions

These terms help keep the summit safe, fair, and professional for every participant.

Registration and tickets

Participants must provide accurate information. Tickets are personal and QR codes must not be shared with anyone else.

Payments

Payment status follows official backend confirmation after validation by the payment provider. Refund eligibility may differ by event or ticket type.

Participant conduct

Participants must respect others, maintain a harassment-free environment, and follow safety instructions and venue rules.

Program changes

The organizer may adjust speakers, schedules, format, or venue when needed and will communicate important updates through official channels.

Last updated: August 1, 2026. Contact the organizer for the policy version that applies to your event.
